name: Southern Gold Road
summary: Caravans and travelers crowd the Southern Gold Road as it runs through the Barrens toward the Great Lift. Trade carries goods between the plains and distant reaches of Kalimdor.

sections.title: Artery of the South
sections.body:
At the stone bridge between the northern and southern Barrens, the Southern Gold Road turns toward the Great Lift and Thousand Needles. Like the northern stretch, called the Gold Road, it takes its name from the merchant caravans that travel its length. Their trade makes the road one of Kalimdor’s busiest long-distance routes, carrying goods between remote outposts and ports.

Quilboar tribes and prowling predators harass those who travel it. Still, caravans and travelers keep moving south.

sections.title: A Crossroads of Distant Lands
sections.body:
Horde couriers and patrols share the Southern Gold Road with merchants and explorers bound for distant lands. Travelers journey between Gadgetzan in the deserts of Tanaris, Auberdine on the shores of Darkshore, and Nighthaven among Moonglade’s sacred groves.

For those crossing Kalimdor’s interior on foot, the sun-baked road makes for a grueling journey. Surviving the trek is a rite of passage.

faq.q: Where does the Southern Gold Road start and end?
faq.answer: The Southern Gold Road begins at the bridge between the northern and southern Barrens and runs south to the Great Lift at the edge of Thousand Needles.

faq.q: Why is it called the Gold Road?
faq.answer: The road takes its name from the valuable merchant caravans carrying precious goods, ore, and coin across Kalimdor.

faq.q: What is the difference between the Gold Road and the Southern Gold Road?
aliases: gold road vs southern gold road
faq.answer: The bridge between the two halves of the Barrens divides the routes. North of it is the Gold Road; south to the Great Lift is the Southern Gold Road.

faq.q: Who travels along this stretch of road?
faq.answer: Horde couriers and patrols use the road, as do merchants and explorers traveling between Gadgetzan to the south and Darkshore and Moonglade to the north.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you rely on the Southern Gold Road to carry supplies between the Barrens’ central crossway and the southern outposts near Thousand Needles.
